implementation.ownedGroups: Every detached command and Metro process is registered. Timeouts, captured-output overflow and SIGINT/SIGTERM request TERM then bounded KILL and await quiescence before returning. Parent exit alone is insufficient; zombie-only states are membership revalidated. Only owned negative PGIDs are signaled; no killall/unrelated process dump.
implementation.cancellation: Signal handlers let pending command unwind through awaited cleanup; no immediate process.exit. Cancellation starts no new simulator cleanup subprocess; ephemeral runner teardown disposes of that dedicated simulator.
implementation.unknownWriters: Failed/cancelled runtime never recursively removes DerivedData/generated project merely because original parent exited. Removal requires explicit passed-run/quiescence evidence; unknown/interrupted global Xcode writer state retains outputs for ephemeral teardown.
implementation.results: Bounded text/status diagnostics always uploaded. Incomplete/unverified raw xcresult excluded. A normally exited, quiescent valid failed-XCTest result remains inspectable and is uploaded separately if <=64MiB; test success is not required for that evidence. Unknown/invalid/oversize result remains on ephemeral runner with a diagnostic hold record.
